data.name: Banshilal
data.gender_notes: Banshilal is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Bansilal or Banshilal is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bans' which means banana tree and 'Ilal' which means protector. The name Banshilal signifies a protector or guardian of banana trees. The name Banshilal carries the meaning “Banana tree protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Banshilal usually hope their child will grow to embody banana tree protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.

The name carries the association of protection and cultivation of these sacred and nourishing trees.
